solo.title: Mr. Robot
solo.reason: FROM YOUR WATCHLIST (94% RT): Psychological hacker thriller with Severance-level mind games. Rami Malek's performance is extraordinary. Complete series - no cancellation risk. This should be your next solo watch.

solo.title: Rectify
solo.reason: FROM YOUR WATCHLIST (96% RT): Critically adored slow-burn about a man released from death row. You value 'great acting' (Murderbot review) - this delivers. Complete 4-season run with satisfying conclusion.

solo.title: Watchmen
solo.reason: FROM YOUR WATCHLIST (96% RT): HBO's superhero deconstruction with Dark/Severance complexity. You're a Marvel completionist who appreciates prestige - this is the best superhero TV ever made. Limited series, complete story.

solo.title: The Sopranos
solo.reason: FROM YOUR WATCHLIST (92% RT): The prestige TV pioneer. You loved Better Call Saul (4★) and appreciate excellent acting/complex characters. This invented the genre - essential viewing.

solo.title: Rosehaven
solo.reason: FROM YOUR WATCHLIST (100% RT!): Australian workplace comedy. You noted watching Australian shows helps 'chat with casting directors'. Parks & Rec energy with Tasmanian charm. Perfect comfort watch.

solo.title: Station Eleven
solo.reason: Post-apocalyptic drama with stunning cinematography. Shares DNA with Severance and Dark - thoughtful sci-fi that rewards patience. Limited series, complete story, no cancellation worries.

solo.title: Succession
solo.reason: Prestige family drama about a media dynasty. Emmy-sweeping acting and razor-sharp writing. Complete 4-season run with acclaimed ending - no fizzle-out risk. If you loved complex characters in Better Call Saul (4★).

solo.title: Maid
solo.reason: FROM YOUR WATCHLIST (94% RT): Limited series about escaping poverty. You said you 'love based on true stories' (Dopesick review). Margaret Qualley gives an Emmy-worthy performance.

together.title: We Were the Lucky Ones
together.reason: FROM YOUR WATCHLIST (94% RT): WWII family true story. Fits your Chernobyl (5★) + Unorthodox (4★) pattern perfectly. Prestige limited series with historical weight - ideal together viewing.

together.title: The White Lotus
together.reason: Dark social satire at luxury resorts - endless discussion material. Each season is self-contained. Sharper than Big Little Lies (3.5★) with similar 'who did it' energy. Emmy-winning ensemble.

together.title: Slow Horses
together.reason: CONTINUE WATCHING: Already rated 4.5★ as 'spy comedy' - your highest-rated together show after Chernobyl. Gary Oldman is perfect. New seasons keep coming - stay current!

together.title: Somebody Somewhere
together.reason: Warm small-town comedy about finding your people. Ted Lasso (4★) heart with more grounded humor. Perfect low-stakes easy watch - no intensity, no crudeness, just warmth.

together.title: Colin from Accounts
together.reason: Australian rom-com about two people who accidentally adopt a dog. Hits your Australian content interest AND works for together viewing. Light, funny, charming - no crude humor.

together.title: The Tourist
together.reason: British-Australian thriller in the Outback. Helen loves spy/action (Bodyguard 4★, Jack Ryan 3.5★) + you love Australian content. Jamie Dornan with amnesia - engaging mystery.

together.title: Reacher
together.reason: Action thriller with Alan Ritchson as the massive ex-military investigator. Good pacing, satisfying action. Similar appeal to Jack Ryan (3.5★) and Terminal List (3★) but better executed.
